definitions.explanation: The lowest permissible or possible value, amount, or level. Used in technical, financial, and everyday contexts to describe the bottom boundary of a range.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下限|かげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Set the lower limit of the temperature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下限|かげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧{名|めい}です。
examples.english: The minimum number of participants is ten.

examples.japanese: ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上限|じょうげん}→上限：11299_jougen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{下限|かげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられて→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧おり、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{範囲内|はんいない}→範囲内：25429_haninai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An upper limit and lower limit are set on the price, and trading is done within that range.

notes:
USAGE: {下限|かげん} is a somewhat formal term used in technical, financial, and regulatory contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下限|かげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧ / ⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to set a lower limit)
- {下限|かげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧ (to fall below the lower limit)
- {下限|かげん}{価格|かかく} (floor price, minimum price)

PAIR: The opposite is ⟦{上限|じょうげん}→上限：11299_jougen⟧ (upper limit, maximum).

NOTE: Do not confuse with ⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧ (adjustment; degree; condition), which has the same reading but different kanji and meaning.
